title: Extension: voice
description: Provider-side routing of a transcribed spoken task to one of its projects. RARELY NEEDED (HP-303): Autonomous routes from AgentCard skills[] names and descriptions by default. Declare this only to override that routing with provider-side knowledge the card cannot express. Each $defs entry carries its own examples.

transcript.description: What the user said, already transcribed by Autonomous.

candidateProjectIds.description: Optional shortlist. When present the provider MUST choose from it or decline.

examples.transcript: check whether acme blew through budget this week

projectId.description: The chosen project, or null to decline and let Autonomous fall back to its own routing.

examples.reason: Names the Acme account and asks about pacing.
